facts.note: The breach succeeded (email data exfiltrated) but the filing reports no operational disruption; it is neither a stopped attack nor an operational hit under the schema definition.

summary: Microsoft disclosed that a nation-state associated threat actor accessed and exfiltrated information from a small number of employee email accounts, including senior leadership, starting in late November 2023 and detected on January 12, 2024; access was removed around January 13, 2024, law enforcement and regulators were notified, and no material operational impact had occurred.
